theme_strategy.reasoning: A serious enterprise tool dealing with dense evaluation data, multi-stakeholder workflows, and sensitive talent decisions requires authority, clarity, and function-first design. We avoid consumer SaaS trends (generic blue, purple AI glows) in favor of high structural contrast and a specialized functional palette.

headings.usage: Use tight tracking (tracking-tight) for large headings. Never center unless explicitly necessary. Work Sans provides a highly legible, slightly structured aesthetic fitting for HR tools.

body.usage: Used for all dense tables, UI labels, and long-form data. Its technical/monolithic structure excels at side-by-side data comparisons and dense numeric/textual grids.

ai_distinction.explanation: To differentiate from generic AI purple/blue, we use Amber/Ochre. It signals 'insight' and 'illumination'. AI panels must strictly use this subtle tint to separate from human-entered white backgrounds.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: The Control Room Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Tight gap-4 to gap-6 for dashboards.
layout_and_spacing.density: High density. Use py-2 px-3 for table cells. Prioritize information density without feeling cluttered. Align numbers right, text left.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Strictly left-aligned for dense forms and comparisons. Optical alignment over geometric.

surfaces.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), NO shadow. On hover, slightly lift (-translate-y-1) and add shadow-sm.
surfaces.header: Solid background (bg-white), hard bottom border (border-slate-200), NO glassmorphism to ensure data privacy and crispness.
surfaces.ai_panel: Subtle amber tinted background, 1px amber border, explicitly labeled 'AI Draft' in the header.

layout_and_spacing.navigation: Role-specific vertical sidebar (or dense horizontal top-nav) + breadcrumbs for deep form nesting.

icons.style: Use regular or bold weights depending on active state. Provides a crisp, technical feel suitable for dense dashboards.

tables.style: border-collapse. border-b border-slate-200 on rows. Highlight entire row on hover (bg-slate-50). Use frozen first column for wide horizontal scrolls.

forms.style: Shadcn based. Tabbed sections for long flows. Sticky summary/status panel on the right sidebar so users always know case context. Use Shadcn select, datepicker, and checkboxes.

ai_interactions.style: Probabilistic UI. Provide explicit confidence flags (e.g., 'Bias Risk: High'). Always pair AI drafts with an 'Edit/Override' and 'Approve' action. AI content should never overwrite human content without a click.

image_urls.description: Abstract architecture, white and gray concrete building. Use with a bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm overlay to keep the login form completely legible.
Black glass walled building. Can be used for dark-mode contextual areas or administrative login.

media.notes: Use Phosphor Icons (e.g., Target, Shield, Users, Vault) in place of generated images for the 3 landing page tiles (MDC, LDC, LFP). Style the disabled tiles (MDC, LFP) with opacity-50 and grayscale.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement Shadcn UI for standard components (Tabs, Tables, Cards, Inputs, Dialogs, Select), but aggressively customize them to remove the 'Vercel look'—make them flatter, high-contrast, with 1px solid borders.
Use Work Sans for all headings and IBM Plex Sans for all body text. Override Tailwind config.
Landing Page: Create 3 large tiles. 'LDC' is active (brand colors, hover effects), 'MDC' and 'LFP' are explicitly grayed out/disabled. Include an Admin Center tile.
Build role-based dashboards with clear KPIs, assigned case lists, and AI Quick Case Brief cards.
Implement the 'Panel Case Review' using a highly dense, side-by-side layout: Document viewer on the left drawer, consolidated table in center, and AI summary form on the right.
Ensure all AI side panels and AI-drafted text areas strictly use the 'ai_distinction' colors (amber tinted) to visibly separate them from human input.
Implement the Status Badge system rigorously using the 10 provided states.
Add 'data-testid' to EVERY interactive element (buttons, tabs, table rows, form inputs) to support enterprise test automation.
